payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a Memphis style interface. Use: bold geometric shapes (triangles, squiggles, circles), bright clashing colors, 80s postmodern aesthetic, playful patterns, dotted textures, asymmetric layouts, decorative elements.
payload.best_for: Creative agencies, music sites, youth brands, event promotion, artistic portfolios, entertainment
payload.css_technical_keywords: clip-path: polygon() for shapes, background: repeating patterns, transform: rotate() for tilted elements, mix-blend-mode for overlays, border: dashed/dotted patterns, bold sans-serif
payload.do_not_use_for: Corporate finance, healthcare, legal, elderly users, conservative brands
payload.effects_and_animation: transform: rotate(), clip-path: polygon(), mix-blend-mode, repeating patterns, bold shapes
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Geometric shapes visible, ☐ Colors bold/clashing, ☐ Patterns present, ☐ Layout asymmetric, ☐ Playful decorations, ☐ 80s vibe achieved
payload.keywords: 80s, geometric, playful, postmodern, shapes, patterns, squiggles, triangles, neon, abstract, bold
payload.secondary_colors: Complementary geometric colors, pattern fills, contrasting accent shapes
